inputs.text: A Wisconsin jury has convicted Harry Wait of election fraud and identity theft for requesting the ballots of Robin Vos and Cory Mason without their consent. The left is quick to paint this as some assault on democracy by a leader challenging their preferred election stories, all to supposedly protect marginalized groups from inequality. That is the usual progressive distortion. In truth, this is another example of left-leaning institutions weaponizing the courts to punish those who question the system and defend the integrity of our processes. Their talk of needed reforms and vulnerable voices is a thin cover for pushing agendas that erode national sovereignty, personal responsibility, and the cultural traditions that have long upheld social order and family values. We cannot let these efforts go unchallenged if we are to preserve authority and continuity in our society.
